narration: In month {fork_month}, after two months without pay, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. That same month {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, the share of each month's pay promised away before it arrived no longer matching between the two lives. By month {end_month} that difference had closed again, and Life finished {life_gap}. The ghost had a thinner cushion against a stretch with nothing coming in, and its Safety finished {safety_gap}. In month {widest_gap_month}, the furthest apart the two lives ever drifted, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
